name: M7.StreamingCost.cursor_projection
statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M7.StreamingCost.Eval) (i fuel : ℕ), (M7.StreamingCost.allFinFrom n p i fuel).result = M7.StreamingIndices.allFinFrom n (fun j => (p j).result) i fuel
guidance: Induct fuel generalizing i, split i<n and (p current).result. Projection follows the identical recursion and short-circuit branch. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.
